about.description: 0XOF is the first West African CFA franc (XOF) stablecoin on Base, issued by Volta Equity Partners Limited Company under the Agbo brand. Pegged 1:1 to XOF, the official currency of the eight-country West African Economic and Monetary Union (WAEMU): Bénin, Burkina Faso, Côte d'Ivoire, Guinea-Bissau, Mali, Niger, Sénégal, and Togo. Reserves are backed by liquid WAEMU sovereign bonds. Acquisition channels include on/off-ramps via local agents, mobile money rails (covering the WAEMU mobile money ecosystem), and direct on-ramp conversions. The platform also features a Nǔ loyalty program where 0XOF holders accrue loyalty points (not native yield).
